notes: Operating income is reconstructed as net property income less corporate expenses and disclosed non-property-FV operating impairments; no blanket addback to FMP operating income.

EBIT is reconstructed as official pretax profit plus finance costs less the signed consolidated investment-property FV gain. EBITDA adds the retained FMP historical D&A. JV FV embedded in share-of-profit is not independently removed from EBIT/EBITDA; these are explicitly consolidated-property-FV-adjusted measures, not fully FV-free group measures.

Attributable NPAT uses only the unitholder distribution bridge's property-FV and related deferred-tax adjustments, already reflecting relevant JV and NCI scope. Other noncash adjustments, impairments, derivative/financial-instrument FV and discretionary distributions are not removed.

FY2021 and H1 FY2021, and H1 FY2024, combine unitholder property FV and other impairments; adjusted NPAT remains unavailable rather than assuming impairment ownership. H1 FY2021 consolidated FV/impairment split is unverified and adjusted EBIT/EBITDA also remain unavailable.

CFO is official statutory operating cash flow, already excluding noncash property FV; it receives no FV addback. FCF is that CFO less cash investment-property and PPE additions. Financing-classified interest remains outside CFO/FCF; FCF is not distributable income or levered equity cash flow.

Adjusted basic EPS uses verified reported basic units. Adjusted diluted EPS is unavailable because changed earnings require re-testing convertible dilution; reported diluted EPS is preserved only in the original provider archive.
H2 flows are annual minus reported H1. H2 cash opens at H1 closing cash; balances are not summed. FY2026 cash movement includes the separately reported HKD45m held-for-sale cash reclassification.
Native FMP forecast rows, model defaults and direct API valuations remain unmodified. Earlier unreviewed history remains explicitly reported, not certified as FV-adjusted.
